_comment: The declared proof must fail with an AssertionError after the exact mutation in an isolated worktree collapses the all-deleted branch into the generic empty branch. The unmutated green replay is a separate E2E invocation, never a second stack inside this Vitest test.

expectedRed.testName: the real @1611 Playwright journey rejects collapsed all-deleted copy
expectedRed.why: The proof changes the production source from `if (hasDeletedTenants) {` to `if (false) {` in an isolated worktree, rebuilds one Docker front runtime, and runs `e2e/tenant-portal-picker.spec.ts --grep @1611 --project chromium`. The journey must fail its visible 'Your organizations are no longer available' assertion. The source worktree stays untouched; the unmutated green replay is run separately by the captain.
